CREATE TABLE "public"."checkoutAttempt" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "errorCode" text,
  "errorDetails" json,
  "errorMessage" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "orderId" text,
  "paymentAttemptId" text,
  "receiptId" text,
  "requestHash" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PROCESSING' NOT NULL,
  "successSnapshot" json,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "checkout_attempt_status_consistency_c207fec0" CHECK (status IN ('PROCESSING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'REJECTED', 'FAILED') AND length("idempotencyKey") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length("requestHash") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND ((status = 'PROCESSING' AND "orderId" IS NULL AND "receiptId" IS NULL AND "paymentAttemptId" IS NULL AND "errorCode" IS NULL AND "errorMessage" IS NULL AND "errorDetails" IS NULL AND "successSnapshot" IS NULL) OR (status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND "orderId" IS NOT NULL AND "receiptId" IS NOT NULL AND "paymentAttemptId" IS NOT NULL AND "errorCode" IS NULL AND "errorMessage" IS NULL AND "errorDetails" IS NULL AND "successSnapshot" IS NOT NULL AND json_typeof("successSnapshot") = 'object') OR (status IN ('REJECTED', 'FAILED') AND "errorCode" IS NOT NULL AND length("errorCode") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "orderId" IS NULL AND "receiptId" IS NULL AND "paymentAttemptId" IS NULL AND "successSnapshot" IS NULL)))
)
